name: Achievements
overview: Scripture reveals that true achievements are found not in worldly wisdom or human traditions but through a personal relationship with Christ, who is the way to the Father and the source of spiritual strength. Despite all having sinned and falling short of God's glory, believers are empowered to do all things through Christ who strengthens them. Genuine accomplishment flows from loving one another as Christ loved us, guarding against deception by philosophies that lead away from Him.
